fusions.name: Spooking Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a loud shot at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 8 piercing damage and stuns it for 0.5 seconds. You hold 3 shots, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Startling Report
fusions.desc: Fires a blast in a cone 5 tiles long that deals 13 piercing damage to everything in it, knocks each hit 3 tiles back and leaves it [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Far Sense
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further.

fusions.name: Return Fire
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, your next strike gains 25% critical hit chance. Once every 6 seconds.
